mapper.select: SELECT id, word, category, action, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM content_sensitive_word WHERE enabled = 1
SELECT phrase FROM content_sensitive_allow WHERE enabled = 1
SELECT id, sha256, dhash, category, enabled, note, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM content_sensitive_image WHERE enabled = 1

SELECT CONCAT_WS('|', (SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(*), '@', IFNULL(MAX(update_time), '')) FROM content_sensitive_word), (SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(*), '@', IFNULL(MAX(update_time), '')) FROM content_sensitive_allow), (SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(*), '@', IFNULL(MAX(update_time), '')) FROM content_sensitive_image))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_sensitive_word (word, category, action, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{word}, #{category}, #{action}, #{enabled}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE category = VALUES(category), action = VALUES(action), enabled = VALUES(enabled), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE content_sensitive_word SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, phrase, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM content_sensitive_allow
AND phrase LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phrase}, '%')
ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_sensitive_allow (phrase, enabled, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{phrase}, #{enabled}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE content_sensitive_allow SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, sha256, dhash, category, enabled, note, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM content_sensitive_image ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_sensitive_image (sha256, dhash, category, enabled, note, create_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sha256}, #{dhash}, #{category}, 1, #{note}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE category = VALUES(category), enabled = 1, note = VALUES(note), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE content_sensitive_image SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_sensitive_hit (source, content_type, content_id, category, action, scan_version, create_time) VALUES (#{source}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{category}, #{action}, #{scanVersion}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, source, content_type, content_id, category, action, scan_version, create_time FROM content_sensitive_hit ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

choose.when: SELECT id, contents AS text FROM ums_comment WHERE id > #{afterId} AND status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, CONCAT_WS('\n', title, body) AS text FROM community_post WHERE id > #{afterId} AND lifecycle = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, content AS text FROM club_post WHERE id > #{afterId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, CONCAT_WS('\n', name, subtitle, description) AS text FROM cms_topic WHERE id > #{afterId} AND user_status = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, CONCAT_WS('\n', name, description) AS text FROM cms_activity WHERE id > #{afterId} AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, CONCAT_WS('\n', name, description, slogan, story_title, service_text) AS text FROM mms_merchant WHERE id > #{afterId} AND status = 1 AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
